title: Open Problems in Integrable Systems — Around the Birkhoff conjecture
exact_target: Prove the conic-pencil conclusion for a convex exterior foliation with projective tangent-line involutions and a rational or algebraic first integral.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2100403 (AMR-020-0403). CC BY 4.0.
A. Bolsinov, V. S. Matveev, E. Miranda and S. Tabachnikov, Open Problems, Questions, and Challenges in Finite-Dimensional Integrable Systems (2018), arXiv:1804.03737, Problem 4.5 and Conjecture 4.3.
